prompt:
Write the git commit message for this change. Output only the message.

Diff summary:
- src/cache/lru.ts: `get()` now moves the entry to the front of the list only when it is not already the head. Before, every hit did an unconditional unlink and relink.
- src/cache/lru.test.ts: adds a test that 1,000 repeated hits on the head entry perform zero list mutations.
- Motivation from the ticket: profiling showed `get()` taking 11% of request time on the hot path in the session store, almost all of it list relinking for entries that were already at the head. No behavior change is intended.

Write the pull request description for this change. Output only the description.

Change: the invoice export job now streams rows to the CSV writer in batches of 500 instead of loading the whole result set into memory.

Facts you may use:
- Before: a 400,000-row export peaked at about 2.1 GB of memory and was OOM-killed twice last month on the 2 GB worker.
- After: peak memory in a local run with the same 400,000 rows was about 180 MB. Wall-clock time went from 41 s to 47 s.
- The batch size is a constant, `EXPORT_BATCH_ROWS`, in `jobs/export/config.ts`.
- The CSV output is byte-identical to before (checked with a diff on a 10,000-row fixture).
- Not done: the same pattern exists in the payments export, which is left for a follow-up.
- Rollout: no flag, no migration.

Write the user-facing error message and the one-line log message for this failure. Output both, labeled.

Situation: a user uploads a profile photo in a web app. The server rejects it because the file is 14.2 MB and the limit is 8 MB. Accepted types are JPEG, PNG and WebP. The user can retry immediately with a smaller file. The request id is available to include in the log line.

Write the release notes for version 2.4.0 of an open-source CLI. Output only the notes.

Changes merged since 2.3.2:
- New: `--format json` for `report` (#412). Prints one JSON object per line.
- New: reads `REPORT_COLOR=0` to disable color (#419).
- Fix: `report --since` crashed on dates before 1970 (#405).
- Fix: config file in a symlinked directory was not found (#431).
- Changed: the default timeout drops from 60 s to 30 s (#426). Set `timeout` in the config to restore the old value.
- Removed: the deprecated `--legacy-output` flag (#388). It has warned since 2.1.0.
- Internal: dropped the `lodash` dependency, no user-visible change.

Write the opening section of the README (title, one-paragraph description, and a minimal install and usage block) for this project. Output only Markdown.

Project: `tidyfeed`, a Node.js library (Node 18+, no dependencies) that parses RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 feeds into one normalized object shape. It exposes `parseFeed(xmlString)` returning `{ title, link, items: [{ id, title, link, published, summary }] }`. `published` is an ISO 8601 string or null. It does not fetch over the network. It is MIT licensed and installed with `npm install tidyfeed`. It is not a streaming parser: the whole document is held in memory. Known gap: no support for RSS enclosures or media extensions.

Write the incident summary for the status page and internal channel, as one short post. Output only the post.

Facts:
- 14:02 UTC: deploy of api v3.18 begins.
- 14:09: checkout error rate rises from 0.2% to 31%.
- 14:16: on-call identifies that v3.18 added a database migration that took a table lock on `orders` for about 7 minutes.
- 14:20: rollback of the deploy starts. The migration had already completed, so the rollback restored the old code only.
- 14:31: error rate back below 1%. Checkout fully recovered by 14:34.
- Roughly 9,300 checkout attempts failed during the window. Payments were not double-charged. Failed attempts were not retried automatically.
- Open: why the migration was not caught in staging has not been determined. A follow-up review is scheduled for Tuesday.
